title: A Field Guide to Style
description: A knowledge hub for visual styles, moods, websites, products, printed works, and objects.
footer: A growing catalogue of visual references.

home.heading: A field guide to|visual language.
home.lede: Websites, tools, printed works, and objects, collected by the mood they create and the ideas worth carrying forward.

notes.heading: Collect the reason, too.
notes.text: Each reference records what makes it useful, where it came from, and how it relates to a style. The notes matter as much as the image.

notes.heading: A collection that can grow.
notes.text: A reference can sit in more than one style. Websites, product interfaces, printed works, objects, and single images share the same record.
